questions.question: Which Scanner method reads an entire line of text?
explanations: next() reads only one word (up to the first space).
Correct. nextLine() reads the whole line up to the Enter key.
nextInt() reads an integer, not text.
read() is not a Scanner method.

questions.question: Why does `nextLine()` after `nextInt()` 'skip' the input?
options: nextInt() leaves the Enter in the buffer, nextLine() consumes it
nextLine() does not work after nextInt
explanations: It is not a bug; it is the normal behavior of the buffer.
Correct. nextInt() reads the number but leaves \n in the buffer. nextLine() reads until \n, finds the pending one and returns an empty string.
It does work, but you need to clear the buffer first.

questions.question: Which package must I import to use Scanner?
explanations: java.lang is imported automatically (String, System, etc.).
